summary: Twelve comment-endorsed tools, services, books, videos, and everyday systems from 30 fully crawled HN threads.
telegram_footer: 12 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: Hermes Agent
items.source_story_title: CEO fired developers to make room for AI. Developers create open source AI CEO
items.summary: An open-source personal agent used as a daily founder boss and business memory.
items.why_included: A founder described concrete help with tasks, fundraising, incorporation, compliance, and staying on track.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Hermes to assign three daily tasks and retain business context, calling it genuinely helpful.

evidence_sources.author: jjcm
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using a Hermes agent to act as my "boss", giving me three tasks to do each day / creating a memory of everything with the business.

items.name: UTM
items.summary: A macOS virtual-machine app for running ARM Linux through Apple virtualization.
items.why_included: A long-term user praised its speed across four generations of Apple Silicon.
items.evidence: The commenter has used UTM for roughly two years and calls it fast and fantastic.

evidence_sources.author: jjtheblunt
evidence_sources.excerpt: it's fast as greased lightning and fantastic. I've used it two or so years on M1, M2, M2 Max, and M5

items.name: Delaware Inc.
items.summary: A company-formation service with incorporation, registered-agent, and compliance support.
items.why_included: A repeat customer endorsed the service as a practical alternative to flashier incorporation products.
items.evidence: The commenter incorporated several companies through the service and consistently found it prompt and reliable.

evidence_sources.author: rattray
evidence_sources.excerpt: to incorporate several companies over the years, and always had a good experience. Their website looks pretty old-school but it works well and their service is very prompt.

items.name: Guidance
items.summary: A language and library for constraining and steering language-model generation.
items.why_included: A commenter gave a concrete early example of making a 7B model implement code against approved tests.
items.evidence: Guidance helped a small local model follow a test-first loop and work toward passing code.

evidence_sources.author: NitpickLawyer
evidence_sources.excerpt: using that library I was able to "guide" the model in the required "prompt / instruct" context such that it was working towards completion

items.name: DNSControl
items.summary: An open-source infrastructure-as-code system for managing DNS across providers.
items.why_included: A direct recommendation included a clever real-world GitHub-managed subdomain registry example.
items.evidence: The commenter explicitly seconded DNSControl and highlighted its use by is-a.dev.

evidence_sources.author: 8organicbits
evidence_sources.excerpt: I'll recommend dnscontrol as well, although the post is an unseasonal April fools joke, so helpful suggestions may be out of place.

items.name: Wispr Flow
items.summary: A cross-platform voice-dictation app that turns speech into polished text.
items.why_included: A Pixel 9 user offered a clear positive comparison with a newer-device-only alternative.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Wispr Flow on Android and says it delivers the promised dictation experience.

evidence_sources.author: blissofbeing
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using Wispr Flow on my pixel 9 and I like it.

items.name: Manufacturing Processes for Design Professionals
items.summary: A richly illustrated reference covering major manufacturing processes for designers.
items.why_included: The recommendation called out unusually strong photography, diagrams, and explanations.
items.evidence: The commenter recommends it as both a comprehensive process reference and a coffee-table book.

evidence_sources.author: nickpinkston
evidence_sources.excerpt: "Manufacturing Processes for Design Professionals" - amazing photos, diagrams, explanations, etc. of every major manufacturing process - great coffee table book.

items.name: Materials Selection in Mechanical Design
items.summary: A mechanical-design reference built around quantitative material-comparison charts.
items.why_included: The commenter specifically praised its Ashby charts for practical property trade-offs.
items.evidence: The recommendation highlights charts that compare properties such as strength against weight.

evidence_sources.author: nickpinkston
evidence_sources.excerpt: "Materials Selection in Mechanical Design" - great book with "Ashby Charts" that let you compare materials against their material properties - e.g. strength vs. weight.

items.name: Telekasten.nvim
items.source_story_title: Emacs 31: An unofficial guide to Markdown-ts-mode
items.summary: A Neovim plugin for Markdown notes, wikis, journals, and zettelkasten workflows.
items.why_included: A commenter described a simple cross-device workflow combining Telekasten with mobile Obsidian.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Telekasten for desktop Markdown notes and considers the setup good enough.

evidence_sources.author: kelvinjps10
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use markdown and nvim with telekasten plugin on desktop and mobile obsidian and for me is good enough

items.name: Euclid’s Elements by Nicholas Rougeux
items.summary: An interactive digital reproduction of Byrne’s colorful 1847 Euclid edition.
items.why_included: It is a distinctive, directly praised modernization of an older printed work.
items.evidence: The commenter calls Rougeux’s Euclid reproduction very beautiful.

evidence_sources.author: pcshah1996
evidence_sources.excerpt: here's a very beautiful reproduction of Euclid's elements

items.name: Yayoi Kusama interview — Louisiana Channel
items.summary: A video interview in which Yayoi Kusama speaks about her life and art.
items.why_included: One commenter strongly recommended hearing Kusama speak, while another said the video changed their life.
items.evidence: The selected source recommends the interview and praises Kusama’s eloquence and verbal expressiveness.

evidence_sources.author: z2
evidence_sources.excerpt: Highly recommend watching her speak, for instance in the below interview. I've found her to be very eloquent and expressive verbally too.

items.name: Suica
items.source_story_title: Suica, Japan's First IC Transit Card
items.summary: Japan’s tap-to-pay transit card for trains, buses, and everyday purchases.
items.why_included: A firsthand report praised both flawless Apple Pay use and near-universal acceptance.
items.evidence: The commenter found Suica excellent, flawless through Apple Pay, and broadly usable.

evidence_sources.author: jjice
evidence_sources.excerpt: Suica was excellent when I had the chance to use it. I used the Apple Pay version and it worked flawlessly.
